shaperCandidateReview.name: harfrust
shaperCandidateReview.finding: Public Shaper::shape returns GlyphBuffer. The buffer wrapper exposes no status accessor for internal hb_buffer_t.successful. Production complete-success observability is not established.
shaperCandidateReview.evidenceType: Pinned release source/API review, not reproduction of a particular shaping failure.
shaperCandidateReview.next: Evaluate observable failure through a proper backend API, including HarfBuzz Native/WASM or an upstream API correction. Do not equate returned glyphs with complete shaping.

limitations: Consumed selected-face metadata/cmap and directory/checksum validation is not a complete font sanitizer or guarantee of renderability. Other faces and unselected cmaps are not fully validated.
Formats 2 and 8, WOFF/WOFF2, embedded-font deobfuscation, font writing/subsetting/embedding, avar/gvar/HVAR/MVAR evaluation and complete resource profiles remain incomplete.
cmap coverage is not cluster shaping. Ligatures, bidi, script/language selection, line breaking, variable metrics, outlines, color glyphs and rendering are not implemented by this component.

FontTools does not implement cmap 10 in the pinned version; that probe uses a separate Python binary observer. Format 1 name language tags have a Rust synthetic test, not target application validation.
The five Noto fonts are fixed test assets, not a default product font pack. Noto Emoji here is monochrome. OFL and OS/2 declarations do not by themselves close product font distribution review.
Native cancellation is cooperative. Synchronous WASM development calls require future host Worker/hard-cancel integration for cancellation during execution.
Earlier 12/18 LibreOffice color differences and geometry roundtrip differences remain open; no new Office or WPS application test was performed.
Full SourceBinding import, object style computation, advanced objects, playback, Agent surfaces and Musterwork integration remain incomplete. E0-E3 and the persistent goal remain open.
